title: Free Concert Tickets
scenario: A post says teens get free concert tickets if they upload a student ID.

answers.A: Ask a trusted adult or school staff through a known channel.
answers.B: Click the link or follow the instruction quickly so you do not miss out.
answers.C: Ask the sender in the same chat to prove it is real.
answers.D: Report/block it and do not share private details.

explanation: Free Concert Tickets: the trap is to pull you away from the normal verification path. The safer move is to ask a trusted adult or school staff, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Student IDs should not be uploaded to random giveaways.
